answer_1.quote: Opinion summarization is the task of automatically generating digests for an entity (e.g. a product, a hotel, a service, etc.), from user opinions in online forums.

answer_2.quote: We report ROUGE F-scores that compares the overlap between generated text with gold summaries... We also compute perplexity (PPL) score to evaluate the readability of summaries... we compute the percentage of distinct n-grams (n = 2)... measure aspect coverage of a system by computing the average number of distinct aspects N ASP in the generated summaries.

answer_4.quote: Summaries were judged by 3 human annotators on three criteria: informativeness, coherence and non-redundancy... Aspect summaries were judged based on two criteria: aspect informativeness... and aspect specificity...
answer_4.guideline: The judges were presented summaries in a pairwise manner and asked to select which one was better/worse/similar. The scores (-100 to +100) were computed using Best-Worst Scaling.
